Method of Attack: Locking files inside password-protected archives instead of encrypting them to evade anti-ransomware detection
Using VMware vCenter Server web client vulnerability CVE-2021-21972 for initial access
Extracting administrative credentials from vCenter server
Using RDP over SSH for lateral movement
Using Jetico’s BCWipe utility to delete traces
Using Python-based ransomware for AES encryption (initial attempts detected and stopped)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of VMware vCenter Server web client vulnerability CVE-2021-21972 via remote code execution on TCP/IP port 443
PowerShell commands to install XMR miners (by different actor)
Indicators of Compromise: Use of .vaultz file extension for password-protected archives
Ransom note demanding 15.95 BTC ($940,000) for full recovery or 0.099 BTC ($5,850) per file
Use of WinRAR archives with strong passwords and encrypted keys
Use of Jetico BCWipe data wiping utility
